title: About SoccerOctopus
intro: SoccerOctopus is an open-source swarm AI engine built to predict every match of the FIFA World Cup 2026.

what.title: What is SoccerOctopus?
what.body: A coordinated ensemble of specialised agents, each analysing a different data source, votes on match outcomes. An aggregator agent synthesises their predictions into final probabilities, goal forecasts, and tournament simulations.

stack.title: Technology stack
items: Frontend: Vue 3 + Vite, Vue Router, account authentication
Inference: OpenAI API (GPT-4o) - aggregator narrative synthesis
Serving: Gunicorn (sync workers, 240 s timeout) behind Nginx
Simulation: Monte Carlo (Poisson goal model) as swarm fallback

agents.title: Swarm agents
items: Statistical Agent (weight 1.8×)|ELO ratings, Poisson model, SofaScore attack / defence stats, head-to-head records.
Video Intelligence Agent (weight 1.0×)|YouTube highlight engagement ratios, title sentiment, tactical momentum scores derived from recent match footage.
Recent Form Agent (weight 1.3×)|Points earned in last 10 official matches, goal rates adjusted by form trajectory.
Tactical Agent (weight 1.2×)|Style-matchup matrix (high-press vs counter, tiki-taka vs defensive block, etc.).
Aggregator Agent|Confidence-weighted ensemble + LLM-synthesised narrative and key factor extraction.

sources.title: Data sources
items: SofaScore - static team attack / defence ratings and ELO
YouTube Data API v3 - video engagement and sentiment
FlashScore - form history and head-to-head results
ESPN public API - live WC 2026 group stage results
